script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: second chances

Begin screenplay.

Title: FRESH START

Genre: Romance

Logline: When a long-lost high school sweetheart resurfaces in the city, a hardened architect is forced to confront his past, reevaluate his priorities, and consider a fresh start.

INT. ARCHITECT'S OFFICE - DAY

A modern architect's office with large windows showcasing the city skyline. JASON (mid 30s, successful, but guarded) is hunched over his drafting table, measuring lines and erasing mistakes.

NARRATOR (voiceover)
Jason, a talented architect, has spent years focusing on his career. His work consumes him, leaving little room for personal relationships.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Jason, sitting at a table, is engrossed in his laptop, designing a new project. A woman, AMY (mid 30s, warm, and radiating charm), enters and takes a seat across from him.

AMY
(smiling)
Hi, Jason. Long time no see.

JASON
(startled)
Amy? Is that you?

Amy, once Jason's high school sweetheart, has returned to the city after traveling the world.

AMY
Yes, it's me. I've come back to reconnect with old friends, including you.

JASON
(stammering)
I-I didn't expect to see you again.

INT. JASON'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jason sits in his dimly-lit living room, brooding over old photographs of him and Amy.

NARRATOR (voiceover)
Memories of their past love flood back, but Jason is conflicted. He's come so far in his career, and opening himself up to another relationship seems risky.

INT. GALLERY - DAY

Jason and Amy stand before an art exhibit, discussing their past, present, and future.

AMY
You've achieved so much, Jason. But what about happiness? Can't you have that too?

JASON
I want to be happy, Amy. But I've invested so much into my work.

INT. JASON'S OFFICE - DAY

Jason sits at his desk, staring at a blank computer screen. He looks up as his assistant, SARAH (late 20s, eager, and ambitious), enters.

SARAH
Jason, we have a potential client coming in at 3. Are you ready?

JASON
(distracted)
Yes, let me just... (pauses, sighs) I'll be there.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Jason and Amy sit at an outdoor table, enjoying the sunshine. They talk about their dreams, their fears, and their regrets.

AMY
(looking into Jason's eyes)
Jason, I understand your reservations. But isn't it worth taking a chance, for the possibility of happiness?

JASON
(considering)
Maybe it is.

INT. ARCHITECT'S OFFICE - DAY

Jason is working on a new design, incorporating elements that represent the depth and richness of his feelings for Amy.

NARRATOR (voiceover)
Jason has made a decision. With Amy by his side, he'll take a fresh start, embracing love and happiness in his life.

INT. JASON'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jason and Amy sit on the couch, wrapped in a blanket, watching the sunset over the city skyline.

JASON
(smiling)
I'm glad you're back in my life, Amy. I'm ready for this new chapter.

AMY
(grinning)
I'm glad I'm here with you, Jason. Let's make this a fresh start, together.

Fade to black.

THE END
